goals.objective: Goal 1: Build AI Prompt Context Pack from docs/AGENT_HANDOFF.md, docs/update_log/2026-06-05_direction_review_through_84acb6cb.md, .omo/plans/condition-research-end-to-end-master-roadmap-20260606.md, .omo/plans/tick-human-like-research-criteria-dashboard-20260605.md, utility/ai_agent/strategy.txt, utility/ai_agent/rules.txt, and utility/ai_agent/system_prompt/v1/*; produce compact prompt guidance for strategy grammar, forbidden syntax, buy/sell structure, and safe examples without token bloat; guardrails: no official engine, hard gate, backtest_graph, protected path, production export, final_approval, live trading, or V3K gate edits. Goal 2: Inject strategy history and examples into generation prompts; prompts must be able to include current and previous buy/sell strategy code, strategy diff, structure patterns, forbidden syntax, selected few-shot examples, and bounded token/complexity metadata; new controls remain default OFF or research-config-only. Goal 3: Inject backtest and analysis feedback into prompts; prompts must be able to include compressed profit, return, MDD, trade_count, payoff, avg_hold, daily stats, generation history, failure reasons, time-bucket analysis, market-cap-bucket analysis, variable correlation, histograms/ranges, and segment feedback as next-generation guidance. Goal 4: Expose prompt context, strategy code, diffs, and analysis in the dashboard; dashboard must show active strategy, previous strategy diff, AI request prompt, used Context Pack, analysis summary, test period/year, time bucket, market-cap bucket, and clear research-vs-proof status with browser evidence. Goal 5: Reduce 09:00-09:30 generated-strategy timeout and complexity; generated strategies must stay within bounded if-node, token, time-window, and market-cap branch limits so backtests can complete within the existing timeout budget. Goal 6: Run evidence-bound recent-period and OOS research flow; continue through 2024-2026 recent-period review, candidate selection/freeze only after evidence, OOS validation, PBO/DSR/slippage/promotion-card checks, and wiki documentation; do not claim human-level or human-superior results unless OOS evidence proves it. Goal 7: Maintain master-roadmap reporting and final verification; at every page or major checkpoint report master roadmap progress, current page progress, results, evidence, risks, and next command; final verification must include prompt-log proof fields, browser evidence, targeted unit tests, git diff --check, python scripts/verify_nonrelease_sync.py, protected-path status, and real observable evidence beyond tests.
